findings.claim: Original 00437F90 is a class-1-only stateful vehicle camera orientation/basis helper taking out[16] and world-object pointer, not a general bounds query: non-class-1 copies constant 004FAED8; class-1 reads two 3xfloat object basis vectors, vehicle runtime+0xD4/+0x114/+0x118, frame dt, calls 00493CA0, 00494C80, 00494710 and updates globals 0052B93C/40/44; direct retail callers are 00406D40 and 00407236. Ancestor traversal occurs in caller outside this function.
findings.limitations: Direct PE analysis and controlled original-x86 emulation, not actual Windows frame. Existing v97 Ghidra semantic label misleading; no baseline rename. Physical meaning of runtime scalar/vector fields not proved.

findings.claim: Original 0045EBD0 allocates a 0xB0-byte node and copies 16 dwords from 004FAED8 into object+0x18, initializing root direction at object+0x30..0x38 to (0,0,1). Original isolated execution with only Windows HeapAlloc substituted completed in 86 steps; 00437F90 executed on that native-initialized root and controlled finite class-1 runtime state without non-finite output words.
findings.limitations: Root node tested with controlled synthetic runtime fields and frame delta, not same-state VCF/full camera; finite output alone does not prove proper orthonormal pose or physical parity.

findings.claim: Original 00493CA0 divides the dot product by squared magnitude of owner+0x30..0x38 without a zero-length direction guard. Setting that direction vector to (0,0,0), either on a manual root or by erasing the three fields on an original native-constructed root, causes 9 nonfinite float32 words from original 00437F90; unmodified native-root direction (0,0,1) gives none for the tested runtime state. Independent runs matched byte-for-byte.
findings.limitations: A controlled Ghidra original-instruction experiment, not evidence that genuine retail gameplay produces NaNs. 00495000 approximation and actual x87 hardware parity not established. Full previous VCF/camera replay not repeated here.

findings.claim: The prior native full-camera harness used a manually zeroed top-level root. Whether running the full selected GTSi/bus camera chain after true native root construction eliminates all NaNs remains untested, as do actual pose writers, parent-chain integration, camera scheduling and hardware x87 normalization parity.
findings.limitations: This run recovers Milestone A input/call contract and isolated nonfinite precondition, not Milestones B/C full finite retail camera/render pass.
